response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Celebrity Cruises, you must call Celebrity customer service directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel advisor. This update cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing Celebrity Cruises booking, you must call Celebrity's customer service directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel advisor. This change cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing reservation, call Celebrity Cruises Customer Service at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel advisor. This update cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. Call Celebrity Cruise Directly: Reach out to customer service at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada).
